title: Next year in Jerusalem
html_source: Jews traditionally end the Passover Seder with the wish, “Next Year in Jerusalem!” The Jewish story can be summed up as a long journey from Egypt to Jerusalem. Beyond being just geographical locations, they symbolize two opposite spiritual states. The journey from Egypt to Jerusalem is a spiritual odyssey, leaving the slavery of Egypt and heading towards the freedom of the Promised Land.
